description: Defines data structures, classes, and global variables related to game entities, player states, logging, and game level management for the Unvanquished game. It includes entity references, player and client data, game state tracking, and build/deploy logs.

classes.name: GentityRef_impl
classes.description: Template class for safe references to game entities that can detect if an entity has been recycled or freed.

methods.name: operator bool
methods.description: Checks if the entity reference is valid and the entity has not been recycled.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Returns the entity pointer if valid, otherwise nullptr.

methods.name: operator->
methods.description: Provides access to the entity's members if the reference is valid.
